en: A monochrome/sepia street scene showing an old European town. Tall, narrow buildings with wooden shutters and small balconies line a cobbled street. A bay window juts out over a corner shop. At street level there are storefronts with awnings and signage, and a group of people in early 20th‑century clothing gather and converse in the square-like intersection. At the top of the card, printed text reads "TRENTO" and "Palazzo Rohr."
